sources.name: original-budget-preflight
sources.excerpt:
## 18. Cost/budget preflight

Before execution define the bounded pilot budget.

Use existing Mission Control budget controls.

Record:

- known model cost basis

- token limits

- retry limits

- Attempt limits

- execution time limit

- other measurable resource limits

If actual monetary cost cannot be determined:

record UNKNOWN.

Do not invent provider prices.

Do not weaken hard-budget admission merely to allow the pilot.

sources.excerpt:
7. BUDGET

==================================================

Resolve the exact budget authority for WorkOrder 1.

Record:

- token limit

- execution time limit

- retry limit

- Attempt limit

- monetary limit where known

- unknown cost components

- reservation/admission behavior

UNKNOWN cost may remain UNKNOWN where actual provider pricing cannot be proven.

UNKNOWN must never become zero.

Do not weaken hard-budget admission.
